The test image shows soybean leaves with:
- Angular to irregular brown/tan spots scattered across leaf surfaces
- Yellowish-green halos around some lesions
- Lesions coalescing in some areas
- Some water-soaked appearance around spots

Top candidates: **Bacterial_Blight** (angular spots with yellow-green halos) or **Septoria_brown_spot** (angular red-brown spots with yellowing). Let me check references.

Comparing the test image against references:

- **Bacterial_Blight** reference: Shows angular spots with yellow-green halos around dark brown centers on green leaves — very similar to the test image
- **Septoria_brown_spot** reference: Shows more advanced heavy yellowing of entire leaves with dense dark brown spots — doesn't match the test image as well

The test image closely matches Bacterial Blight: angular/irregular brown lesions with distinct yellowish-green halos on otherwise green leaves in what appears to be mid-upper canopy.
